AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Sparely is a personal finance and savings app. These functions are read-only: they answer questions about the user's spending, monthly budgets, savings vaults, account balances, upcoming bills and wishlist, and cannot change any data. Operational patterns: - Amounts are in the currency given by each response's currencyCode. - Dates are ISO-8601: YYYY-MM-DD for days and YYYY-MM for months. - Use 'searchExpenses' for individual transactions and 'getSpendingSummary' for totals. Constraints: - If a function fails because assistant access is turned off, tell the user to enable 'Allow AI assistants' in Sparely under Settings > Security. Do not retry until they have.
